opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK‑based institutions (universities, charities, NGOs, etc.). Individuals must have a formal employment or contractual relationship with the host institution for the project duration. Excludes individuals without formal employment, projects led by unaffiliated individuals, schools, further education colleges, undergraduate or master’s students, PhD‑fee projects, establishment of academic posts, ongoing costs, local charities, and organisations not based in the UK (except in exceptional cases).
opportunities.summary: Supports research addressing one or more of the five priority questions set out in the Foundation’s Strategic Review, offering up to £500,000 (or up to £750,000 in special cases) per grant for UK‑based researchers.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Encourages applications from individuals and organisations, particularly from racially minoritised communities, based in the UK. Partnership applications that bring together researchers and racially minoritised communities are strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, with grants ranging from £15,000 to £500,000, focusing on inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges in a racially diverse society.
